claims.label: thm:main
claims.title: 低温有序KMS态存在
claims.statement: For each integer d>=3 and each positive half-integer S there is finite beta0(d,S)>0; for every finite beta>=beta0 a translation-invariant beta-KMS state has omega(Sz_0)>=S/4.
claims.conditions: Nearest-neighbor coupling-one isotropic Heisenberg model on Zd; existential threshold, fixed d,S. A selected state, not the finite zero-field Gibbs mean, rotational average, Bloch coefficient or effective critical temperature.

claims.label: lem:slot-realization
claims.title: 对称槽实现
claims.statement: ell=2S spin-one-half slots restricted to the site-symmetric subspace realize spin S; full Hamiltonian and magnetization commute with the symmetrizer, with Hhat=-sum U_edge/2+qLambda I/4.
claims.conditions: All ell squared slot pairs per site bond and unordered edges once. Individual edge transpositions need not preserve the symmetric subspace; do not interchange compression and arbitrary products.

claims.statement: Finite-cube partition function equals exp(beta qLambda/4) times the base expectation of 2^cycle_count; magnetization spectral observables follow fair independent cycle colors conditional on the weighted picture.
claims.conditions: Finite cube, positive finite beta, physical spin spectrum. Color independence is conditional on the picture; the picture itself is cycle weighted. qLambda is the slot-edge count, not the number of physical bonds.

claims.conditions: Finite volume, any beta>0, finite E optionally united with D0. The law for r has more pins; replacing it with the smaller-pin law would change the input.

claims.label: prop:first-moment
claims.title: 条件下一钉首矩
claims.statement: For V=J disjoint union Q, J nonempty and the exterior-moment identities, all-hit probability is det(I-KQQ). If positive, KQQ is transient and the conditional next-pin mean is the Schur-complement first-positive hitting kernel. Arbitrary complex W determinant identity also holds.
claims.conditions: Use column-forward matrices. An empty Q is permitted. The probability must be positive for conditioning/inversion; all mean entries are recovered, not only the trace. No full path-law equality follows.
